commands.command: QUANSIO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=<private database> cargo test -p quansio-machine -p quansio-tools -p quansio-native-windows  # computer_receipts 16, computer_sequence 14, computer_permission 8, computer_helper 11, computer_use 6 (EXEC-010's, unchanged), tools computer_receipt 4, all pass. Proves: unknown verification is null on the wire and never rounded; a background claim is re-derived from its measurement; terminal conditions (stop, takeover, revoked permission, each limit) end a sequence with the model asked and the platform reached the asserted number of times; the takeover race (a takeover requested while an action is in flight); a missing permission parks with the attention item and nothing reaches the bridge; a crash mid-sequence leaves the call active and a restart does not retry it; the Tool Registry carries the one canonical receipt and refuses a loosened one

cargo test -p quansio-machine --test computer_helper -- --nocapture  # 11 passed against real /usr/bin/codesign and real signed executables: wrong identifier, unsigned, not hardened, altered after signing and ad-hoc-vs-production-requirement are each refused with COMPUTER_HELPER_IDENTITY_REFUSED; versioned install with a re-verified copy, rollback, prune, probe restore; an altered installed copy (even re-signed) is refused at launch; orphaned helpers are terminated and nothing else is

QUANSIO_TEST_MACOS_COMPUTER_USE=1 swift test --package-path native/macos  # 42 tests, 0 failures, 1 skipped (the pre-existing real-VM test, BLOCKED_EXTERNAL); live: permission probes agree with the system's own answers, a real one-point pointer move is seen by the background measurement, a real clipboard write is receipted, measured and verified by read-back, an unauthorized foreground is refused before anything is written

cd apps/desktop && npx vitest run --exclude tests/work.e2e.test.ts && npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit; npx eslint apps/desktop  # 182 passed, 12 skipped (e2e tests that need services), typecheck and eslint clean; permissions.test.ts has 29 tests. work.e2e.test.ts is excluded from this run because it is flaky on the base commit too (see NOTES.md)

uv run --project python pytest tests/architecture tests/contract tests/ci  # 239 passed (test_generated_bindings_are_current deselected: the Rust contract generator cannot run from a worktree under .claude/worktrees)
python3 mutation-checks.py (in this bundle; run on commit 820c7dc)  # 50 mutants of the guards, every one COMPILES and every one KILLED by a named test after CONTROL-PASSED on the unmutated suite
cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings  # clean

python3 scripts/validate_v81.py; arch_check.py; workspace_check.py; inventory.py --scan; check_authority.py; legacy_map_check.py; supply_chain/check.py; gen_contracts.py --check --only catalog,openapi,ts,sdk  # all CLEAN / PASS

QUANSIO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=<private database> cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast  # 1030 passed, 13 failed across 155 suites: all 13 are artifact/evidence-store calls to MinIO (127.0.0.1:59010), which was not running (BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: the dev stack's object store); none touches this task
